title: A/R Detail: each row belongs to its own document's location
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has, on today's date, an invoice {Invoice-A} made at {Location-A} for $500.00 and partly paid ($200.00) by a payment taken at {Location-B}, a credit memo {Credit-memo-A} made at {Location-B} and a deposit {Deposit-A} taken at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-15 Where It Lives.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing {Customer-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location column of {Invoice-A}, {Credit-memo-A} and {Deposit-A}.
  2. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Expand every bucket and read the rows.
  4. Open the Location menu, tick {Location-B} and untick {Location-A}.
  5. Expand every bucket and read the rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Invoice-A} shows {Location-A}; {Credit-memo-A} and {Deposit-A} show {Location-B}.
  • Step 2: the report narrows to {Location-A}; the Location column is hidden.
  • Step 3: only {Invoice-A} remains, with its open balance of $300.00 ($500.00 − $200.00): the payment taken elsewhere does not move it.
  • Step 4: the report narrows to {Location-B}.
  • Step 5: only {Credit-memo-A} and {Deposit-A} remain.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S5-R7: “which location an A/P row belongs to, stated per document (bill: its delivery; vendor credit from a return: the return; other vendor credits: the vendor).”
  • Key Decisions, row location: “A row belongs to the location of its own open document (the invoice, credit memo or deposit; the bill or vendor credit), the same location the Location column shows. Rationale: the aging reports list open documents, not payments, so a partly paid invoice keeps its own location and the filter never contradicts the column. Rejected: splitting a balance by where each payment was taken.”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
